Generated metric definitions for snapld_state gauge.

# Purpose
This header defines the generated metric metadata for the `snapld` tile and exposes one gauge entry in the `FD_METRICS_SNAPLD` table. The `FD_METRICS_GAUGE_SNAPLD_STATE_*` macros assign the metric offset, name, type, description, and converter for `snapld_state`, which reports the tile state with values for `IDLE`, `PROCESSING`, `FINISHING`, `ERROR`, and `SHUTDOWN`. The file includes `fd_metrics_base.h` and `fd_metrics_enums.h` so the metric definition uses the shared metric types and enum values used across the codebase. The include guard prevents multiple inclusion, and the comment states that `gen_metrics.py` generates the file and that it must not be edited by hand.
